summary: Avoid queue enrichment and repeated incarnation reads while revalidating fault snapshots

replay.detail: No replay or projection rebuild is introduced.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or index changes.

rules.detail: Attention items, fault episodes, ownership and current-state fences are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Fault revalidation reads only stored step fences and reuses each subject's incarnation within one snapshot call. A later snapshot reads current state again; no new cross-snapshot cache or wire changes.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or migration is required.

recovery.detail: No persisted state is changed. Reverting restores the previous read path without migration.
